tokens.name: leaf-700
tokens.usage: Brand green, taken from the D mark. Headlines and the wordmark on paper-50 (7.2:1); fill for brand panels and chips with paper-50 or white text (7.8:1).

tokens.name: forest-900
tokens.usage: Deep forest. The dark ground for carousel CTA slides, exhibition footers and dark info slides. Text on it: paper-50, turmeric-500 (6.9:1), mango-500, citrus-500.

tokens.name: olive-500
tokens.usage: Second green, the word 'Produce' in the colour wordmark. Large text only (3.6:1 on paper-50) — use it for 36px+ sub lines and accents, never for body or footer text.

tokens.name: paper-50
tokens.usage: Rice-paper ground for festival, info and CTA slides. Default post background; never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Footer strip and panels sitting on paper-50 or on photos. Text on it: leaf-700 or ink-900.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Body and headline text on paper-50, paper-100 and every fruit tint (12:1+).

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Muted text on paper-50 (7:1): info lines, captions inside the post, dates under headlines.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text and the reversed wordmark on photos (always over scrim-forest), on leaf-700 and on fruit deep colours.

tokens.name: turmeric-500
tokens.usage: Festive accent: frames, rules, dots, date circles, eyebrows on forest-900 (6.9:1). Never text on paper (2:1).

tokens.name: scrim-forest
tokens.usage: Gradient stop laid over photos under white text so headlines always clear 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pomegranate-700
tokens.usage: Pomegranate posts: sub lines, rules, numbers on paper-50 or pomegranate-100 (6.2:1+).

tokens.name: pomegranate-900
tokens.usage: Pomegranate posts: footer strip and side bands, with paper-50 text (12.8:1).

tokens.name: pomegranate-100
tokens.usage: Pomegranate posts: blush ground for inner carousel slides. Text: ink-900 or pomegranate-700.

tokens.name: mango-500
tokens.usage: Mango posts: fills, discs, rules; text only on forest-900 (7.6:1).

tokens.name: mango-800
tokens.usage: Mango posts: sub lines and numbers on paper-50 or mango-100 (6.4:1).

tokens.name: mango-100
tokens.usage: Mango posts: warm ground for inner slides. Text: ink-900 or mango-800.

tokens.name: grape-600
tokens.usage: Grape posts: fills and rules; large text only (3.7:1 on paper-50).

tokens.name: grape-800
tokens.usage: Grape posts: sub lines, numbers and footer strip (7:1 on paper-50; paper-50 text on it).

tokens.name: grape-100
tokens.usage: Grape posts: fresh green ground for inner slides. Text: ink-900 or grape-800.

tokens.name: citrus-500
tokens.usage: Kinnow / citrus posts: fills, discs, rules; text only on forest-900 (5.5:1).

tokens.name: citrus-800
tokens.usage: Kinnow / citrus posts: sub lines, numbers and footer strip (6.7:1 on paper-50).

tokens.name: citrus-100
tokens.usage: Kinnow / citrus posts: ground for inner slides. Text: ink-900 or citrus-800.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Why October matters for Indian pomegranates
styles.usage: One per slide. The hook. Max ~8 words, max 3 lines.

styles.name: hero-italic
styles.sample: The finest of produce from India
styles.usage: Optional warm second line under a hero (festivals, exhibitions). Never stacked with a sub.

styles.name: festival
styles.usage: Festival and day-of names only, uppercase, one or two words.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a hero or title. One line.

styles.name: sub
styles.sample: Peak harvest. Superior quality. Global export readiness.
styles.usage: One sentence under the hero. Often in the fruit's 700/800 colour.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fresh harvests begin across Maharashtra and Karnataka, so supply is steady and grading is consistent.
styles.usage: Inner slides and greetings. Max ~35 words per slide.

styles.name: info
styles.usage: Small facts: dates, venue, a source line.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: The contact strip at the bottom of every post.

tokens.name: safe-margin
tokens.usage: Minimum inset from every post edge for text and the logo.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between a photo card and text, or between two columns.

tokens.name: stack-lg
tokens.usage: Between hero block and the next block (photo, details, footer).

tokens.name: stack-md
tokens.usage: Between eyebrow, hero and sub.

tokens.name: stack-sm
tokens.usage: Between lines of a list or a label and its value.

tokens.name: footer-height
tokens.usage: Height of the contact strip at the bottom of every post.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, date boxes, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Photo cards inside slides, event-logo card, checklist panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, date circles, the arch top of festival photo windows.
